newsitem.title: EGYPT: PLO's Arafat due in Egypt for pre-summit talks.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Arafat due in Egypt for pre-summit talks.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is due in Cairo on Monday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak ahead of an Egyptian-Israeli summit, government officials said.
Mubarak and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu are set to meet in the Red Sea resort of Sharm el-Sheikh on Tuesday on ways to revive peace talks between Israel and the Palestinians.
Talks have been frozen since March 18, when Israel started to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
